findings.problem: This proof is a roughly 30-line argument with two parts. (1) A `cancel_mono` argument, `hcomponent`, shows `coneComponent = restrictOnNamedPreimage …`. (2) A three-step `calc` rewrites the colimit coprojection law and finishes with `restrictOnNamedPreimage_Γ_map`. It is copied almost line for line in `originalStage_nativeCommRingCylinderSectionsComparison` (NativeCommRingCylinderSections.lean), in `originalStage_restrictedGlobalSectionsComparison` (NativeCylinderComparison.lean), and again as `coneComponent_eq_named` (NativeCylinderOpenNaturality.lean). The only differences are the name of the comparison map φ and the colimit_ι lemma. The calc never uses anything specific to AddCommGrp, CommRing or the chosen-limit comparison. It uses only the law `colimit.ι … i ≫ φ = Γ.map (restrictedCone …).π.app … ≫ eqToHom …`. Part (1) is also redundant. `coneComponent` is defined in NativeCylinderLimit.lean as exactly `restrictOnNamedPreimage (m.π.app (op i.1)) (stageOpen …) (coneOpen …) (coneOpen_eq_stage …)`, so `hcomponent` should hold by `rfl` or `unfold coneComponent`. The monomorphism argument then proves a definitional equation, and it is copied four times.
findings.proposed_change: In NativeCylinderLimit.lean (or a new generic file importing NativeOpenRestriction), over generic `C` and `N`, add one lemma. Possible name: `originalStage_of_colimit_ι`. Take a morphism `φ : colimit ((restricted N i0 U0).rightOp ⋙ SheafedSpace.Γ) ⟶ m.pt.presheaf.obj (op (coneOpen N i0 m U0))`, with `[HasColimit …]` as needed, and a hypothesis `hφ : ∀ i, colimit.ι … i ≫ φ = SheafedSpace.Γ.map ((restrictedCone N i0 m U0).π.app (op i)).op ≫ eqToHom (SheafedSpace.restrict_Γ_obj m.pt (coneOpen N i0 m U0))`. The conclusion is the current statement: `eqToHom (restrict_Γ_obj …).symm ≫ colimit.ι … i ≫ φ = (m.π.app (op i.1)).hom.c.app (op (stageOpen N i0 U0 i)) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg … (coneOpen_eq_stage N i0 m U0 i).symm)`. Proof sketch: rewrite with `hφ i` via `← Category.assoc` or `congrArg`, then `simp only [restrictedCone]`, then `exact SheafedSpace.restrictOnNamedPreimage_Γ_map …`. The step `rw [hcomponent]` is replaced by `unfold coneComponent` or `rfl`. The step `show … from rfl` may be needed because `restrictedCone`'s `π.app` is `coneComponent` by definition. Each use then becomes `originalStage_of_colimit_ι S i0 m U0 _ (colimit_ι_nativeAdditiveCylinderSectionsComparison S i0 m U0) i`. The CommRing, chosen-limit and OpenNaturality versions become one-line calls as well. This works under the actual hypotheses: the use here has `S : ιᵒᵖ ⥤ SheafedSpace AddCommGrpCat` and `hφ := colimit_ι_nativeAdditiveCylinderSectionsComparison S i0 m U0`. The lemma is stated for a generic `C` and applies to all four uses.
findings.benefit: This removes about 30 lines from each of four files, about 120 lines in total. The `cancel_mono` and `restrictOnNamedPreimage_Γ_map` argument then lives in one place, stated once with its real hypothesis. The argument is the same whatever sections functor sits above it. A change to `coneComponent`, `restrictedCone` or the transport conventions is made once rather than in four near-identical proofs. Each user file keeps only its own comparison definition and coprojection law. Dropping the redundant `hcomponent` also removes an apparent but unneeded mono argument.
